Transport Modes

Anhängerkupplung

A towing device fitted to vehicles or trailers, designed for secure coupling to a tow bar or trailer tongue, in compliance with ECE R55 and SAE J684 standards.

Quick answer: A towing device fitted to vehicles or trailers, designed for secure coupling to a tow bar or trailer tongue, in compliance with ECE R55 and SAE J684 standards.

Questions and answers

What is Anhängerkupplung?

In this glossary, Anhängerkupplung refers to: A towing device fitted to vehicles or trailers, designed for secure coupling to a tow bar or trailer tongue, in compliance with ECE R55 and SAE J684 standards.

How is Anhängerkupplung used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Die Anhängerkupplung muss entsprechend dem Anhängergewicht und den Anforderungen der ECE R55 geprüft und zugelassen sein."

Definition

A towing device fitted to vehicles or trailers, designed for secure coupling to a tow bar or trailer tongue, in compliance with ECE R55 and SAE J684 standards.

Operational example

The tow hitch must be rated and tested according to the weight of the trailer and the requirements of ECE R55.
